mimiincubator-desc: Structured course-tree and skill editing for Mimi
newcourse-summary: Name the pair of languages a course bridges. If somebody has started it, you will be taken to it; if nobody has, you will be taken to a blank course to write.
mimiincubator-auth-email-required: An email address is required: your Mimi account is the same one you use on the rest of Mimi, and it is registered by address as well as by username.
mimiincubator-auth-rejected: Mimi could not create the account: $1
mimiincubator-auth-unavailable: Mimi's account service cannot be reached right now, so the account was not created. Try again in a moment.
mimiincubator-auth-unavailable-change: Mimi's account service cannot be reached right now, so your password was not changed. Try again in a moment.
mimiincubator-auth-currentpassword-help: The password you use for Mimi now. Changing it here changes it everywhere you sign in to Mimi.
mimiincubator-auth-retype-help: Type the new password again, to catch a typo in it.
mimiincubator-auth-change-wrongpassword: That is not your current Mimi password. Your password has not been changed.
mimiincubator-auth-change-elsewhere: This account's password is held by Mimi, not by the wiki, so it cannot be changed here. Use [[Special:ChangeCredentials/MimiPassword|Change your Mimi password]] instead; the new password will work on every Mimi site.
